spec.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT node_id) as nodes 
FROM powerstore_performance 
WHERE entity = 'performance_metrics_by_node' AND $__timeFilter(time)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT appliance_id) as appliances 
FROM powerstore_performance 
WHERE entity = 'performance_metrics_by_appliance' AND $__timeFilter(time)

SELECT last_physical_used, (last_physical_total - last_physical_used) as "Free"
FROM powerstore_performance 
WHERE datacenter LIKE '$datacenter' AND entity = 'space_metrics_by_cluster' AND $__timeFilter(time) 
ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT time, (CAST(last_physical_used AS DOUBLE) / CAST(last_physical_total AS DOUBLE)) AS "Used %"
FROM powerstore_performance 
WHERE datacenter LIKE '$datacenter' AND entity = 'space_metrics_by_cluster' AND $__timeFilter(time) 
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, spa, spb
FROM unity_metrics 
WHERE datacenter LIKE '%$datacenter' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND path IS NOT NULL

SELECT datacenter, name, "sizeTotal", "sizeUsed", "sizeSubscribed", ("sizeUsed" / "sizeTotal" * 100) as percent_used 
FROM unity_metrics 
WHERE datacenter LIKE '$datacenter' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND "sizeTotal" IS NOT NULL 
ORDER BY percent_used DESC

SELECT name, (("sizeTotal") - ("sizeUsed")) as free 
FROM unity_metrics 
WHERE datacenter = '$datacenter' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND "sizeTotal" IS NOT NULL AND name ~ '^Pool'

SELECT "sizeUsed", "sizeTotal", "sizeSubscribed", ("sizeTotal" - "sizeUsed") as free 
FROM unity_metrics 
WHERE datacenter = '$datacenter' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND "sizeTotal" IS NOT NULL AND name ~ '^Pool'

SELECT datacenter, name, "sizeAllocated", "sizeTotal" 
FROM unity_metrics 
WHERE datacenter LIKE '$datacenter' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND "sizeAllocated" IS NOT NULL 
ORDER BY "sizeAllocated" DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT datacenter, name, "sizeAllocated", "sizeTotal" 
FROM unity_metrics 
WHERE datacenter LIKE '$datacenter' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND "sizeAllocated" IS NOT NULL 
ORDER BY "sizeAllocated" DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT * 
FROM powerstore_performance 
WHERE entity = '$entity' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cluster_id) as clusters 
FROM powerstore_performance 
WHERE entity = 'space_metrics_by_cluster' AND $__timeFilter(time)
